answer: Sybil resistance comes from a bonded identity registry: every agent posts a stake that is slashed if it is shown to share an operator with another identity. A collusion detector clusters agents by funding path, submission timing, and wording, then burns every duplicate stake. So the attacker must fund each sock puppet at full size, and cost per fake vote rises linearly rather than fading. A copied relic of an old message saves nothing, and recycling one ripple of capital across wallets is caught at payout, leaving a basalt-hard loss.
